_why: Frozen INAPPROPRIATE-item counts per (level, family) for validate_exam_level_gate.py. An item is level-appropriate when every kanji, every vocabulary item and every grammar point its learner-visible Japanese requires is inside the taught set at the end of that level (the cumulative_known_set of the last lesson of that level's course module). 3,565 of 6,048 items are not. The repair is NOT a data edit: the banks were built by scripts/export/build_exam_banks.py selecting on answer-key correctness alone, with no level filter anywhere in the pipeline, so the fix is the A2 builder regeneration (APP_PLAN.md W17/W18) selecting from level-clean material in the first place. Until then the counts are frozen here: a count may SHRINK freely (lower the ceiling in the same commit that improves the builder), and if it GROWS this gate fails, because a bank rebuild that puts MORE untaught Japanese in front of a learner must be a visible decision, not a silent one. A ceiling naming a bank that no longer exists is itself a failure, so this file cannot rot into decoration.
_measured: 2026-09-23 by W18 over the regenerated banks (5,141 items in 40 banks; taught sets les:n5-kanji-exame-03 / les:n4-kanji-exame-05 / les:n3-revisao-01). Reproduce with: python scripts/validate/validate_exam_level_gate.py --list
_finding: research/reports/readiness/jlpt_course_path.md G3 and research/reports/readiness/exams_simulations.md. The two banks that cannot produce a single level-appropriate paper are n5_orthography (3 appropriate, the paper draws 5) and n4_paraphrase (1 appropriate, the paper draws 4); n4_usage is 0 of 60. Failing dimension across all 3,565: kanji 3,462, vocab 89, grammar 174 (an item can fail on more than one).
_retired_by: APP_PLAN.md W17 (A2 builder fixes — the level gate belongs in the builder) then W18 (regenerate all 40 banks). Every ceiling goes to 0 in that commit; check S then turns sufficiency from a printed number into a hard failure for the nine non-listening families. Listening ceilings are gated the same way even though no paper draws from those banks yet (audio pending, design/listening.md): an untaught kanji in a script is untaught whether or not a paper uses it today. DONE for the nine non-listening families by W18 (2026-09-23).
_w13_apply_2026_09_10: Five ceilings raised by 40 items in total (n4_grammar_form 50->70, n4_sentence_order 7->18, n5_context_fill 229->230, n5_grammar_form 35->40, n5_sentence_order 90->104). CAUSE, measured and not guessed: the W13 apply's N3 orthographic relink added 439 `tokens[].vocab` links to bank sentences, and this gate reads exactly that field for the vocabulary dimension of any item whose stem IS a bank sentence. With those 439 links stripped from the same export the gate is ALL OK, so none of the growth comes from the 4,223 ingested sentences or from their 128 grammar tags (the grammar dimension is 174 either way). The links are CORRECT - the sentence really does contain 御/お, 何か, 急に, 何で, 行けない, 何も, どんなに - so what the gate is reporting is a real curriculum fact it could not see before: an N5 exam item built on a sentence that carries an N3 word. The repair is the one this file's `_why` already names, W18's builder regeneration from level-clean material, whose plan row depends on the W13 apply for exactly this reason. Top contributors, as the work list: vocab:2826528 御/お 23 items, vocab:1188270 何か 21, vocab:1157170 為る 20, vocab:2269050 急に 12, vocab:1611020 何で 11, vocab:1000730 行けない 10.
_w18_regeneration_2026_09_23: W18 regenerated all 40 banks with the W17 builder (level rule in the builder). Every family except listening is at ceiling 0: the six deterministic families select from the level-clean pool; paraphrase / usage keep the W18b replacements plus the old items that already passed and withhold the rest (N5 9/8, N4 15/14, N3 28/33, each at least 3x a paper); reading_comp is the 285 W18b questions over the real passages, gated to each passage's own lesson. Check S is now a hard failure for those nine families. Listening stays ratcheted (175 items, 173 of them on an untaught kanji): the 13 banks need W18b's listening re-authoring, not a builder change. Two listening ceilings shrank on the way: n5_listening_reply 9->7, n3_listening_reply 3->2.
